pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/brain/bands.test.tsx:24 The canvas test replacement bypasses checking with as never without documenting the invariant that makes the partial recorder sufficient, failing the standard's per-use invariant requirement.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/brain/useBrain.ts:55 Transcript acquisition stays in the React query driver, which passes arrived values to synchronous model functions.
apps/console/src/pages/brain/engineModel.ts:130 summariseLedger uses explicit sequential accumulation for totals, route statistics, account statistics and run start times.
apps/console/src/pages/brain/brainModel.ts:157 Funnel and latency decisions consume ordinary event collections and return values without fetching, waiting or consulting ambient time.

apps/console/src/pages/brain/bands.test.tsx:24 The assertion bypasses the native context return type without stating at the use site which operations the consumer requires and why Recorder supplies them.
apps/console/src/pages/brain/brainModel.test.ts:78 The model's inputs are directly constructible generated values, so its decisions do not require a host-minted input or a mirror conversion.
apps/console/src/pages/brain/brainModel.ts:237 buildBrainModel hides lane grouping, pulse bounding, memory sampling and statistical aggregation behind three input collections and one display model.

declined.reason: withdrawn after review: reviewer (sonnet): The seat says LiveFeed 'silently' ignores seek, but player.ts:254 documents the no-op, FeedSnapshot exposes a `live` flag, and Layer1.tsx:96 disables the scrubber when `snap.live`, so this is a deliberate, surfaced capability limit rather than an undisclosed contract breach.
